September 2026 Watchlist: The TV shows to watch this week and month

VOD News | On 31, Aug 2026

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 2:02
Instaread

Netflix. Amazon Prime Video. BBC iPlayer. NOW. Apple TV. Paramount+. All 4. There’s so much TV to watch these days in so many places that it can be hard to keep up. Every month, we boil down what’s on the box to the essentials you need in your streaming queue.

Netflixreviews

We’ve sorted through All The TV to bring you your September 2026 UK TV highlights – what’s worth watching and where you can stream it online in the UK.

Week 1

 

It’s Always Sunny in Philadelphia: Season 18

The hilariously dark comedy returns for another round of depraved mishaps.

UK air date:

When? 1st September (0.01am)
What channel? Netflix UK

Watch online in the UK:

Netflix UK (£9.99 a month)
Available all at once on-demand

 

Chad Powers: Season 2

Chad Powers is a superstar on the field but his odd behavior off it has everyone suspicious – especially Coach Hudson and Gerry. Ricky knows the truth, but if Russ and Danny want Chad to survive the regular season and lead the Catfish to the College Football Playoff, she’s their only hope.

UK air date:

When? 3rd September
What channel? Disney+ UK

Time& Calendars

Watch online in the UK:

Disney+ UK (£7.99 a month)
Available weekly on-demand

Taskmaster: Season 22

Chloe Petts, Isy Suttie, Matt Lucas, Nina Conti and Richard Ayoade line up for Channel 4’s hilariously silly competition, overseen as ever by Greg Davies and Little Alex Horne.

UK air date:

When? 3rd September (9pm)
What channel? Channel 4

Watch online in the UK:

Channel 4 (Free)
Available weekly live and on-demand

The Gentlemen: Season 2

With Bobby standing in the way of expanding the criminal empire, Eddie and Susie must decide whether to fall in line or make their own moves. From director Guy Ritchie, the darkly comic thriller inspired by the film of the same name returns, starring Theo James and Kaya Scodelario.

UK air date:

When? 3rd September (0.01am)
What channel? Netflix UK

Netflixreviews

Watch online in the UK:

Netflix UK (£9.99 a month)
Available all at once on-demand

The Grand Tour: Season 6

James, Francis, and Thomas are officially in the driving seat for a new edition of Amazon’s motoring show.

UK air date:

When? 4th September
What channel? Amazon Prime Video

Watch online in the UK:

Amazon Prime Video (£5.99 a month)
Available all at once on-demand
